options.name: ackqueue
options.description: QOS acknowledge queue

options.name: action
options.description: The action of the rule

options.name: after
options.description: Rule to go after, or C(top)

options.name: before
options.description: Rule to go before, or C(bottom)

options.name: destination
options.description: The destination address, in [!]{IP,HOST,ALIAS,any,(self),IP:INTERFACE,NET:INTERFACE} format.

options.name: destination_port
options.description: Destination port or port range specification. This can either be a alias or a port number. An inclusive range can also be specified, using the format C(first-last)..

options.name: direction
options.description: Direction floating rule applies to

options.name: disabled
options.description: Is the rule disabled

options.name: floating
options.description: Is the rule floating

options.name: gateway
options.description: Leave as C(default) to use the system routing table or choose a gateway to utilize policy based routing.

options.name: icmptype
options.description: One or more of these ICMP subtypes may be specified, separated by comma, or C(any) for all of them. The types must match ip protocol. althost, dataconv, echorep, echoreq, fqdnrep, fqdnreq, groupqry, grouprep, groupterm, inforep, inforeq, ipv6-here, ipv6-where, listendone, listenrep, listqry, maskrep, maskreq, mobredir, mobregrep, mobregreq, mtrace, mtraceresp, neighbradv, neighbrsol, niqry, nirep, paramprob, photuris, redir, routeradv, routersol, routrrenum, skip, squench, timerep, timereq, time

options.name: in_queue
options.description: Limiter queue for traffic coming into the chosen interface

options.name: interface
options.description: The interface for the rule. Use 'any' to apply to all interface (for floating rules only).

options.name: ipprotocol
options.description: The IP protocol

options.name: log
options.description: Log packets matched by rule

options.name: name
options.description: The name the rule

options.name: out_queue
options.description: Limiter queue for traffic leaving the chosen interface

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol

options.name: queue
options.description: QOS default queue

options.name: queue_error
options.description: Raise an error if a specified queue is missing

options.name: quick
options.description: Set this option to apply this action to traffic that matches this rule immediately

options.name: sched
options.description: Schedule day/time when the rule must be active

options.name: source
options.description: The source address, in [!]{IP,HOST,ALIAS,any,(self),IP:INTERFACE,NET:INTERFACE} format.

options.name: source_port
options.description: Source port or port range specification. This can either be a alias or a port number. An inclusive range can also be specified, using the format C(first-last)..

options.name: state
options.description: State in which to leave the rule

options.name: statetype
options.description: State type

options.name: tcpflags_any
options.description: Allow TCP packets with any flags set.

options.name: tracker
options.description: Rule tracking ID. Defaults to timestamp of rule creation and not modified if not set or set to 0.
